summary: The agent failed the neonatal sepsis harmonization task due to unit conversion direction errors, incorrect thresholds, and precision violations (rounding to 2 decimals instead of preserving full precision). The existing clinical-lab-harmonization skill assumes SI→US conversion, but this task required US→SI conversion for many analytes (creatinine, BUN, glucose, bilirubin) and US→US for CRP. The agent also applied rounding which violates the 'NEVER ROUND' rule that exists in the skill but was violated in implementation. Created a new neonatal-lab-harmonization skill with bidirectional unit detection, correct physiological thresholds for neonates, and strict no-rounding enforcement.
